subject: Re: Project Kestrel kickoff — staffing + compute
body:
Dmitri,

Kestrel staffing and compute:

Staffing — Linnea leads the training-stack integration and the ablation matrix; Ondrej owns eval methodology (he wants BLEURT as primary metric with chrF as the sanity check, matching how the release was validated); Kaia handles the blob-level vs sentence-level comparison, which is the part most relevant to our document-translation customers; Maren builds the corpus-mixing tooling.

Compute — training runs for the ablation matrix (3 decoding strategies x 2 granularities x 2 directions, plus web-crawl baselines) fit within our standing titan-a100 share if we serialize; ~5 weeks of queue time. I considered asking for a vulcan slot to parallelize but the serialization actually matches our milestone spacing, so no reservation and no discretionary budget ask this half.

Data is already mirrored internally from the release zip; tsv parsing was trivial.

Daniela
